message.content:
This editorial illustration for Tempo magazine features a man standing on the left side, slightly hunched over while pushing down on a tall, red hand pump. He wears a light-blue, long-sleeved button-down shirt tucked into dark trousers and brown shoes. A thin black hose extends from the base of the red pump across a flat, light-colored surface.

The background on the right is dominated by a large, pale-blue concrete overpass structure supported by thick, cylindrical columns. The columns appear slightly distorted or bulging at their bases. In the distance, several rectangular buildings rise into a pale sky. A thick black line with white dashes runs alongside the base of the overpass.

Large red block letters at the top spell "TEMPO." Other legible text includes: "KURSI KABINET UNTUK AGUS YUDHOYONO?", "KEPALA BNN SOAL JEJARING NARKOBA ARTIS", "GADUH UTANG JOKOWI", and several lines of smaller black text. The bottom right corner contains a barcode, numerical data, and the date "7-13 AGUSTUS 2017." A solid red vertical border lines the left edge of the frame.
